app.title: BlueCLI
app.tagline: A minimal client for the Sentinel dVPN network.
wallet.menu.title: Wallet
wallet.prompt.password_new: Choose a password to encrypt your wallet:
wallet.error.already_exists: A wallet already exists. Delete it first if you want to replace it.
wallet.warn.write_mnemonic: Write these words down on paper and keep them safe. This is the ONLY way to recover your wallet.
main.menu.title: Main menu
main.label.keep_open_hint: (Leave this window open — closing it will disconnect the tunnel.)
multihop.title: Multihop (V2Ray chain)
multihop.intro: Pick an entry and an exit node. Your traffic goes you -> entry -> exit -> internet. Both must be V2Ray TCP nodes.
multihop.prompt.entry: Entry node number (or 'b' to go back):
multihop.prompt.exit: Exit node number (or 'b' to go back):
multihop.confirm: Chain {0} (entry) -> {1} (exit) for {2} each. Total {3} DVPN. Proceed?
multihop.not_enough_nodes: Not enough known TCP V2Ray nodes for a chain yet. Connect to a few V2Ray nodes normally first (that fills the local cache), then come back.
multihop.resume_prompt: Resume the existing chain ({0}) without paying for new sessions?
multihop.partial: Some sessions were started but the chain didn't come up. Sessions still active: {0}. End them under 'My active sessions', or retry from 'Multihop' to resume.
connect.bringing_up_wg: Bringing up the WireGuard tunnel (this can take a few seconds)...
connect.bringing_up_v2ray: Starting V2Ray local SOCKS5 proxy (this can take a few seconds)...
connect.wallet_not_funded: Your wallet has no DVPN yet. Send some DVPN to {0} to activate it on chain, then try again.
connect.insufficient_balance: Insufficient balance: this session costs {0} DVPN, but your wallet only holds {1} DVPN.
connect.no_matching_price: Node does not accept {0}. Pick a different node.
disconnect.done: Disconnected. The session is still active on chain — reconnect from the sessions menu without paying again.
sessions.live_expired: A session backing your tunnel has expired on chain, so it was no longer routing traffic. I've disconnected it and restored your normal connection.
sessions.quota_warning: Session {0} is at {1}% of its quota. When it runs out the tunnel stops passing traffic (it does NOT fall back to your normal network) — reconnect to a new session before then.
sessions.reconnect_one_only: You can reconnect to only one session at a time.
settings.menu.title: Settings
settings.prompt.grpc: New gRPC endpoint (host:port, leave empty to cancel):
balance.not_on_chain: 0 DVPN (wallet not yet on chain — send any amount to your address to activate it).
connect.orphan_session: The session #{0} is created on chain but the local tunnel could not start. You can retry by browsing the same node again, or end it from the My active sessions menu (this costs gas and does not refund the unused balance).
connect.disconnect_first: Disconnect first (press 'd' in the main menu), then come back here to connect to a different node.
sessions.prompt.help: Enter a number to reconnect, or a list + 'e' to end (e.g. '1e', '1,3,5e', '*e' for all). [b]ack to leave.
sessions.reconnecting_chain: Reconnecting the multihop chain from cached credentials...
sessions.chain_creds_missing: Can't resume this chain — its cached credentials are no longer available. You can still end the two sessions individually, or start a fresh multihop.
sessions.node_unreachable: Node {0} can't be reached right now.
nodes.loading_empty: Got 0 nodes after probing the network. Either every node is offline or the chain returned an empty list.
nodes.loading_failed_with_error: Could not load the node list: {0}
nodes.filter_none: No nodes match filter {0!r}. Type / to clear.
connect.using_cached_creds: Using cached credentials from a previous handshake (no chain hit needed).
connect.session_already_registered: Session {0} is already registered on the node from a previous attempt, but we no longer have the credentials. The node refuses a second handshake by design. End this session from the sessions menu (<num>e) to free the chain record, then create a fresh one.
connect.verify_route_failed: No traffic reached the internet through this node (it may be down or blocked on this network). I've torn the tunnel down and restored your normal connection — try a different node.
connect.verify_dns_failed: The tunnel reached the internet but name resolution isn't working through this node, so pages won't load by name. I've restored your normal connection — try a different node, or this one again later.
